summary: While much of the wealth generated during technological booms is captured by flashy consumer applications, the most reliable way to profit from the artificial intelligence gold rush is by supplying the foundational **picks and shovels** rather than gambling on volatile software startups. Instead of competing with major tech giants in building expensive foundation models, savvy entrepreneurs can capitalize on the **unsexy, essential infrastructure** required to keep data centers and semiconductor manufacturing facilities running smoothly. Beyond physical maintenance and energy services, everyday businesses can achieve substantial **margin expansion** by integrating artificial intelligence into their existing workflows to automate repetitive tasks and cut operational costs. Ultimately, the true purpose of the text is to demonstrate that financial success in the modern economy comes from **owning the underlying systems** and using intelligent tools strategically rather than trying to predict the outcome of the market.
